requirements.description: Deliver the entire selected labeled result as one or more proved Lean theorems.
Define the upper-triangular computed Cholesky factor and its successful-completion semantics, including the rounded square root.
Prove the symmetric perturbation identity and gamma(n+1) bound using the product of the entrywise absolute factors.
Connect the result to the actual construction and the original mathematical inputs.
Preserve the stated hypotheses and generality. Do not assume the conclusion or introduce a circular definition.

The theorem is not about the submitted algorithm and its original inputs.
